decision.article_title: SC seeks wider drug price regulation, questions high markups on medicines, medical devices - pharma.economictimes.indiatimes.com
decision.reason: India Supreme Court questioned the breadth of proposed pharma/medical-device trade margin controls beyond certain oncology drugs; explicitly still under consideration, not enacted. Modelling proposed margins under documented scenario labels is plausible but market research required.

opportunities.idea_name: India Drug Margin Proposal Scenario Ledger
opportunities.core_job: Estimate effect on distributor/trade margin and SKU economics under proposed/non-enacted price cap scenarios
opportunities.target_customer: Indian pharmaceutical distributors, device suppliers and pricing/compliance finance teams
opportunities.product_mechanism: Imported SKU MRP/invoice and purchase price table → propose 30% margin/alternate cap across affected category → margin stress and human legal/policy review record
opportunities.why_now: India Supreme Court 12 Oct hearing pressed government to consider expanding proposed 30% trade margin cap beyond designated cancer medicine; court inquiry is NOT a final enforceable nationwide cap
opportunities.before_state: Pricing committees must model uncertain proposed caps and carve-outs in detached spreadsheets with unclear effective dates
opportunities.after_state: Revision-labeled hypothetical exposure dashboard and lawyer-approved action queue with explicit proposed/not-enacted label
